description: ASCII components, backgrounds and media for the web: loaders, toasts, transitions, animated hero backgrounds, and image, video and GIF to ASCII. GPU-rendered, themeable, framework-agnostic.
rules: Install the published package: npm install asciify-engine.
For interface components and backgrounds, start with asciify-engine/kit: one call per component, e.g. fieldBackground(el, { preset: 'hero', clear }) or buttonLoading(el).
Use asciify-engine (or /core) for image, video, GIF and text conversion, /hover for pointer effects, /studio for art styles and export, and /field only for a look the kit has no option for.
Ink fields from the page's theme through the --ascii-ink and --ascii-ink-strong CSS tokens; never add a brand colour.
Call destroy() (or the returned stop function) on unmount. In React, create the handle in an effect and return its destroy.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion with a still, and provide a poster for when WebGL2 is unavailable (isGlyphFieldSupported()).
